programme.desc: Two men fall journey into the far-reaches of China, but stumble upon a cave where Princess Wendy, her handmaid Mandy, and evil Tin have been in suspended animation for 800 years..

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 逃學英雄傳
programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

programme.title: 新流氓醫生
programme.desc: University of Hong Kong graduate Situ Luo was a young, highly skilled and promising physician. Ann, a nurse in the same hospital with him, was his girlfriend. Because of work, Luo felt that he could not take care of his girlfriend, and then proposed break up to Ann. He introduced her to her long-admired friend and colleague Xi. Unexpectedly, Xi was shot dead. Only Luo was beside him before he died, so he became the biggest suspected murderer. Because of brain stimulation and loss of memory, Luo then pleaded guilty and was sentenced to prison..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 情義心
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taiwan. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky..

programme.title: 光影年華: 五億探長雷洛傳 II之父子情仇
programme.desc: Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC...

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: Yip has had bad luck ever since her teenage days. She decides to seek help from famous Feng Shui expert Lai, who discovers that her bad luck is causd by his rival..

programme.title: 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity..

programme.title: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 衛斯理藍血人
programme.desc: Wesley is a member of the United Nation Aliens Analyzing Agency, and no stranger to extraterrestrial sightings. This time he finds himself face to face with Fong, a blue-blooded alien stranded on earth. Wesley and his girlfriend So promise to help Fong, but they must first combat FBI's powerful X Unit, who intends to capture Fong for their experiments. Making matters worse is the arrival of two aliens from Fong's home planet, determined to kill anyone that prevents them from retrieving their own species..

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship..

programme.title: 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 旺角揸fit人
programme.desc: As the triad boss Lek-kuen is dying after being shot, he remembers how he became a triad member. Under the influence of Brethen Sheung-yee, Lek-kuen joined the triad society. Yet, Lek-kuen is so kind in nature that his superior and colleagues always betray him. He escapes to Japan but is still attacked by enemies, embroiling his wife Wooden Cart Noodle being killed. Afterwards, Lek-kuen becomes the worst guy among the triad members. At this moment, the story returns to the space-time when Lek-kuen is dying. In fact, he trumps up the mentioned story. The truth is that Lek-kuen does all kinds of evil but he survives from assassination. During the tussle between the Japanese triads and Hong Kong police, Lek-kuen is saved by a mysterious lady. Nevertheless, he is finally shot dead though nobody knows who the murderer is..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 四人新世界
programme.desc: Fei is the master cook in Hong Kong, while his son Suckling has established himself as a real estate salesman in Canada. Suckling sends for his father to join him in this new chapter of their lives. Happily, Fei hops on a plane to Canada. During the flight, he has the good fortune of meeting Yim Chau, a young woman traveling to join her aunt in Canada. Subsequently, Fei meets Yim Chau's aunt and Suckling meets Yim Chau. Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts..

programme.title: 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..

programme.title: 每天嚇你八小時
programme.desc: 'Ghost Invasion'- Tung, who has a simple and pure mind and just started his new job, is quickly attracted by his cool but sexy boss – Sam. At the same time, he meets with his secondary schoolmate in the company – Mick. Mick always talks about women with Tung, he even sets a goal of ‘counting on Sam'. Later, Tung always meets Sam because of overtime work. Sam always changes the style and image when she comes out from washroom at night, which she turns to be seducing, charming and totally different from the one at daytime...'A Horny Ghost'- The boss of a pornographic films dubbing company is a horny man, he is accidentally killed because of a sexual harassment. However, his colleagues are still being sexually harassed by him even he is a ghost now...'The Queen of Gossip'- Amanda, who is the queen of gossip, is noisy and like to exaggerate everything. Even her friends can never escape from her, any good news of her friends will be violated and changed to a bad news. The stranges.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: Steve Backshall journeys the globe with some of the greatest travellers on the planet as he explores the reasons that drive their epic voyages and the challenges migrating whales face.

programme.title: 波斯-伊朗歷史的起源 第1季
programme.desc: In this first episode, Samira journeys to places rarely seen by western audiences to reveal how the Persian Empire was born, the mysterious writing of its early people and how Iran's powerful kings built a vast empire that became the envy of the ancient world.

programme.title: 工廠走透透 第10季
programme.desc: Paddy McGuinness visits a factory in Wales that makes more than four billion biscuits a year.

programme.desc: British comedian and travel enthusiast Griff Rhys Jones explores the prairies and vast sprawling plains of both Saskatchewon and Alberta provinces and discovers they reveal riches from fossils to farmland.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth 第1季
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth
programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Once homeless and a teen-mom, Dot leaves the big city for a much needed adventure alongside Bear Grylls. She's overcome life's biggest challenges but has never tackled the wild. Her emotional journey is a truly inspiring tale of survival.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第1季
programme.desc: When a 13-year-old girl scout needs help earning a primitive camping skills badge, Bear Grylls flies to the rescue… literally. Beth’s wisdom for life and the outdoors is beyond her years, but nothing can prepare her for what challenges bear has in store for this adventure.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: After a morning on the Bayou, the Duck Camp Dinners crew enjoy a fresh cooked dinner while discussing the changing coastal wetlands of Louisiana. Jean-Paul gets to finally a hunt an area he had only heard about as a young man, and takes in the beauty of the live cypress trees this camp is known for.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: After a late night of good times, venison chili, and some old school roux the crew heads out for another day of hunting ducks. Adaptability is critical, and after a couple of quick adjustments the team finds themselves back in the ducks.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.title: Billy Goes North 第1季
programme.desc: Billy and Terry make an urgent call to a wedding venue where wild turkeys are threatening to ruin the big day. Then Billy responds to an apartment where poisonous exotic pets are threatening the homeowner.

programme.title: Billy Goes North 第1季
programme.desc: Billy and Beekeeper Ian extract a bee colony from a family home, then Billy has to dodge talons and beak to remove a Great Horned Owl from a house.

programme.title: Secrets of the Great White Shark 2024 第1季
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Great White Shark
programme.desc: Feature documentary studying the history of the sharks species, alongside their anatomy and how they’ve helped our oceans for hundreds of millions of years. However, in the modern age they face extinction and demonisation. Over 1000 million sharks are killed every year, and it is up to us to save them.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth 第1季
programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第1季

programme.title: Heavy Load 第1季
programme.desc: A pirate ship on a voyage. The Kogas - a retired pirate ship, is to start a new life as a noble restaurant in Berlin. But the journey to get there will be difficult, for the Kogas is docked in Lithuania. A risky and extremely difficult heavy transport over a distance of one thousand kilometres lies ahead. Because the Kogas weighs almost fifty tonnes, a special ship will take it across the Baltic Sea to Poland, and from there across the Oder and the Havel Canal to Berlin. The last journey of the Kogas - a huge logistical task where not everything will always go according to plan.

programme.title: Get Out Alive with Bear Grylls 第1季
programme.desc: The contestants are helicoptered to the top of a glacier, where they must navigate unforgiving terrain and dangerous crevasses. With high altitudes and fewer resources, the tasks become more demanding. Divided, the four remaining teams compete for a spot in the final journey.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季
programme.sub-title: Northern Territory: The Tranquil and Adrenaline Outback
programme.desc: Sara explores Yellow Water billabong in Kakadu National Park at sunrise, and learns about the diverse native flora and fauna.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季第4集 -Western Australia: Broome - The Pearl of Western Australia
programme.desc: Sara explores Yellow Water in Kakadu National Park. She learns about the different birds that visit Yellow Water and prepares an Australian-Asian fusion feast.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: Getting around this city is like navigating a bee hive...except the bees are driving cars, trucks and trikes.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: Get Out Alive with Bear Grylls 第1季
programme.desc: In the season finale, survival expert Bear Grylls selects the winner of $500,000 after a relentless journey to New Zealand’s West Coast --‐ a wet, rainforest amidst torrential downpour where only one team will “Get Out Alive”.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: After eight days in the wild, the physical strain is taking its toll on the four remaining celebrities - but they know a place in the final is within reach. For their first task, they split into two teams and build rafts to get them safely across an estuary. However, the tide is coming in and with it the danger of a shark attack. Once across they each have to build their own shelter, to demonstrate what they have learnt from their experience, and are shocked by Bear's demonstration of how to stay hydrated when there is no clean water available. Will they take up the challenge to repeat his very personal method or walk.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: Finalists Samantha Barks, Jason Gardiner and Alex Scott fight it out to be crowned ultimate mission survivor. The first task sees the trio traversing a rocky coastline and performing a commando crawl 80ft above crashing waves. They no longer have any rations, so they must then forage for seafood in the shallows and rockpools, before joining Bear, Meg and Scott around the campfire to reflect on the competition. The next morning, Bear has a couple of surprises to see how they react to adversity, and then they face their last two challenges - making fire, a primary skill for a survivor, and racing to the top of a 65ft sheer cliff face.

Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: After eight days in the wild, the physical strain is taking its toll on the four remaining celebrities - but they know a place in the final is within reach. For their first task, they split into two teams and build rafts to get them safely across an estuary. However, the tide is coming in and with it the danger of a shark attack. Once across they each have to build their own shelter, to demonstrate what they have learnt from their experience, and are shocked by Bear's demonstration of how to stay hydrated when there is no clean water available. Will they take up the challenge to repeat his very personal method or walk.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第2季
programme.desc: Finalists Samantha Barks, Jason Gardiner and Alex Scott fight it out to be crowned ultimate mission survivor. The first task sees the trio traversing a rocky coastline and performing a commando crawl 80ft above crashing waves. They no longer have any rations, so they must then forage for seafood in the shallows and rockpools, before joining Bear, Meg and Scott around the campfire to reflect on the competition. The next morning, Bear has a couple of surprises to see how they react to adversity, and then they face their last two challenges - making fire, a primary skill for a survivor, and racing to the top of a 65ft sheer cliff face.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Back in Eastern Europe, Catfish and Rooftop start their visit Ukraine dropping into the country via skydive. The adventures only get crazier from there- from wrangling pigs and racing ostriches to testing out if their heads can survive a Spetsnaz bottle break. After testing out the bottle break the duo move onto sambo, a Soviet style of wrestling and equally challenging event. The BMX bikers become the first people to trick at Chernobyl (and get a lifetime ban), but before they head out to their next stop, the two finish their trip just like they came in- airborne. Only this time they’re leaving by fighter jet.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: With their travels taking them to Asia, Rooftop and Catfish find themselves spending several dangerous days in Bangladesh. The pair put their bodies and safety to the test harvesting honey the Bangladeshi way, transporting workers via row boat, deconstructing ships for scrap metal, and trying to clean one of the country’s rare public restrooms. They test out Bangladeshi cuisine in the form of fish, cow stomach, and goat brain curry, and race some locals on their rickshaw bikes. The trip concludes with Rooftop and Catfish heading out of town by train- only running across the top. With all of Bangladesh’s physical dangers, can the BMX bikers make it out without a hospital visit.

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer 第1季
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the\nhumpback whales of Australia. Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.desc: It's the final day at Duck Camp for Jean-Paul and the guys. They finish up their trip with a morning of hunting followed by an afternoon filled with crawfish and catfish. The trip ends on dry land and the crew reflects on what makes the duck camp so special.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation 第2季
programme.desc: When Dick Cabela founded “Cabela’s”, he was unaware that it was to become the foremost outfitting store in the world. So it is fitting that his son is on a quest to explore the Hard Truths of conservation. programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

Join Dan Cabela on this high-impact journey of discovery as he uncovers some of lesser known facts in the conservation world. In particular, the role that hunting and the utilization of wildlife can play as a modern day conservation tool.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer 第1季
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the\nhumpback whales of Australia. Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Back in Eastern Europe, Catfish and Rooftop start their visit Ukraine dropping into the country via skydive. The adventures only get crazier from there- from wrangling pigs and racing ostriches to testing out if their heads can survive a Spetsnaz bottle break. After testing out the bottle break the duo move onto sambo, a Soviet style of wrestling and equally challenging event. The BMX bikers become the first people to trick at Chernobyl (and get a lifetime ban), but before they head out to their next stop, the two finish their trip just like they came in- airborne. Only this time they’re leaving by fighter jet.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: With their travels taking them to Asia, Rooftop and Catfish find themselves spending several dangerous days in Bangladesh. The pair put their bodies and safety to the test harvesting honey the Bangladeshi way, transporting workers via row boat, deconstructing ships for scrap metal, and trying to clean one of the country’s rare public restrooms. They test out Bangladeshi cuisine in the form of fish, cow stomach, and goat brain curry, and race some locals on their rickshaw bikes. The trip concludes with Rooftop and Catfish heading out of town by train- only running across the top. With all of Bangladesh’s physical dangers, can the BMX bikers make it out without a hospital visit.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

The BMX bikers become the first people to trick at Chernobyl (and get a lifetime ban), but before they head out to their next stop, the two finish their trip just like they came in- airborne. Only this time they’re leaving by fighter jet.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: With their travels taking them to Asia, Rooftop and Catfish find themselves spending several dangerous days in Bangladesh. The pair put their bodies and safety to the test harvesting honey the Bangladeshi way, transporting workers via row boat, deconstructing ships for scrap metal, and trying to clean one of the country’s rare public restrooms. They test out Bangladeshi cuisine in the form of fish, cow stomach, and goat brain curry, and race some locals on their rickshaw bikes. The trip concludes with Rooftop and Catfish heading out of town by train- only running across the top. With all of Bangladesh’s physical dangers, can the BMX bikers make it out without a hospital visit.

programme.desc: Addison's excitement at bringing Eureka and Gyro in for a show and tell at school turns to consternation when Donnie turns up with a robot that can do everything hers can do – only better! There has to be a sneaky mystery involved, and Addison is determined to solve it.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -不情願的賽車之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex's record-setting soap box derby car seems like a shoe-in to win the annual race – until something or someone makes it mysteriously slow down to a crawl. Has it been sabotaged? Addison only has an hour till race time to solve the mystery.

programme.title: 電力大魔法 -導電性
programme.desc: An accident rescuing a piece of toast from the toaster leads Smorph to find out how some materials conduct electricity and some do not.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -寶特瓶
programme.desc: Watch Hepi and Briko transform plastic bottles into something out of this world. Literally.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -牙刷
programme.desc: Be prepared to be ''brushed'' off your feet with this entertaining episode.

programme.title: 優可 -人人為我, 我為人人
programme.desc: Each of the kids wants to play a different game, but when the competition gets too fierce, they must use teamwork to play together.
programme.category: Adventure, Nature, Enironment, Educational, Animation / nan

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -偵探日
programme.desc: Ricky is ready to reveal his latest diamond-encrusted arty creation but is shocked to discover it has been stolen! Detective Gav comes to the rescue. Meanwhile, Ricky gains inspiration from artist Iris Scott and her fingerprint painting.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -環境戰士日
programme.desc: Ricky is surprised to find out that Rich wants to live off the land and become one with nature. It inspires Ricky to make a pineapple plant pot while the Grand Master crafted some truly magnificent blooming flowers.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -洗髮精便便日
programme.desc: A new episode of the internet sensation 'Punkest Prank' inspires Ricky and Gav to prank each other to win a year's supply of Shampoo Poo. Ricky enlists his friends, the ninja apprentices, to help him make prank fake food.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -滑雪與滑水
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents printable pancakes, a way to get power from rivers, the physics behind a waterslide, and windmills the size of a flea that could revolutionise electric power.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -寫程式的女孩
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents a former politician who is teaching girls to code, a fold-up kayak, headlights for running shoes,and a woman who invented a new way to keep food fresh.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -神聖的巧力
programme.desc: The Maya were crazy about chocolate. Unfortunately, not everyone could enjoy it. Rare and precious, cocoa was reserved for the powerful. But when you're a food lover like Howler, you'll do anything to enjoy your favourite drink.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -海上交通事故
programme.desc: The Spanish Coast Guard is calling for the MeteoHeroes' help to prevent potentially harmful cargo from falling into the sea! Pluvia and Nix are on their way to save the day.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -那是什麼味道
programme.desc: Residents of a farming community in the USA have complained about a mysterious, terrible odor! It's up to the MeteoHeroes to find and eliminate the source of the stink. But that's not all. Penguin Peeguu detects a distress call from a group of chickens.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -環境行動主義者
programme.desc: Kids meet an environmental activist.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓咖啡廳
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat cafe.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去紐約
programme.desc: In New York, Hogie makes friends with Marie, who shows them around the city. And luckily for Marie, the gang might be able to help her with her school project.

programme.title: 達文西科技學習中心 -程式語言
programme.desc: How does a computer understand what we want it to do? We use a language that it can understand. Find out about all the different types of languages that are used in programming.
programme.category: Science, Technology, Computers, Educational, Animation / nan

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -家長日
programme.desc: On 'Bring Your Parents To School Day,' Travis, Hawk, Joy, and Astoria can't enlist their parents. Rose tries to convince her mom to return to Regal Academy, but catches the attention of Melvin, Merlin's troublemaking grandson, who challenges her to a magic duel.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -煙火為何會綻放
programme.desc: Fireworks were invented in China and were originally thought to be able to get rid of evil spirits and bring good luck. One of the most important components in fireworks is gunpowder. The different metal salts produce the colours.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -哪種蔬菜最迷幻
programme.desc: A fractal is a pattern that keeps repeating itself at different scales. The Romanesco cauliflower is a great example of a natural fractal. There are a lot of fractals in nature: in ferns, rivers, coastlines, mountains and clouds, for example.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -德胡普: 希望之地
programme.desc: The explorers search a colony of rare and endangered vultures that live high in the secluded mountains of the Western Cape. They come upon a refuge for animals, where unexpectedly they catch a glimpse of the largest mammal on the planet.
programme.category: Animals, Nature, Environment, Adventure, Educational / nan

programme.title: 大自然的奧秘 -美麗的昆蟲陷阱
programme.desc: The New Zealand glow worm is the larva of a small fly. They spin a glowing network of mucus covered lines along the cave roof. This supports them and keeps them safe. It may look pretty, but it's really a trap they use to catch insects.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -古卡馬: 最後的荒野
programme.desc: While exploring the picturesque Garden Route, the Zebrabus stumbles onto a hidden retreat with some of the highest vegetated dunes in South Africa. They face snakes and other reptiles before venturing out to sea in search of sharks.
programme.category: Animals, Nature, Environment, Adventure, Educational / nan

醫生與你
programme.desc: 痔瘡由肛門血管組織腫大或發炎引起，常見症狀包括排便時有鮮紅色的血，又或肛門痕癢、疼痛甚至有異物感。痔瘡成因包括長期便秘、久坐久站、懷孕、不良排便慣等等。輕微的痔瘡有機會透過保守治療（如藥物、飲食調整）來緩解症狀。如果痔瘡持續發作，並有出血、垂脫（脫肛）或發炎等，而保守治療又無效時，則或需以結紮或手術治療。. 痔瘡十分常見，很多患者見排便有血也不以為意，但此徵狀與其他疾病相似，如肛裂、大腸癌及直腸癌等，所以見大便帶血時不能掉以輕心，以免延誤病情。. 本集請來外科專科醫生，詳細講解痔瘡的成因、徵狀、預防及治療方法。. 主持︰梁凱寧、黄秉康醫生. 嘉賓︰傅志聰醫生(瑪麗醫院結直腸外科主管).

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集聚焦賽事選手背後以不屈赴夢，以熱血傳神的故事，走進全盲運動員楊曉婷、單腿球王何憶義、九金王蔣裕燕，以及新疆盲人足球隊等代表人物的世界。他們身殘志堅，不懼命運挑戰，以勇往直前的信念追逐夢想，用汗水澆築榮耀，生動詮釋「向陽而生」的力量，弘揚中華體育精神，讓每一份堅持都閃耀光芒。. 播映時間：2月3日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了螢火蟲保育基金會螢火蟲館副館長傅敬勛，分享有關香港螢火蟲的保育知識。本集以邊褐端黑螢及雷氏螢作例子，以全面生態視野去探索螢火蟲的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生態保育工作.

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第三集連詩雅/戰神跑. 〈跑者愛分享〉－連詩雅. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與連詩雅（Shiga）從科學園奔向大埔海濱，重溫她們人生初半馬終點相擁而泣，到跑步路上的並肩前行。兩位媽媽分享懷孕心得：「適量運動分泌安多酚，胎兒都會跟住開心！」在專注腳步中甩開煩惱，見證她們以腳步編織的健康與友誼！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－跑步，都有禮儀？. 跑步也有潛規則？標準運動場上的八條跑道，各有學問：慢跑選外線、快跑靠內線、統一逆時針跑，原來都有原因！跑步時亂玩手機、突然變速或左右亂衝，不僅會妨礙別人，更容易釀成意外。超越別人要怎樣示意才夠禮貌？減速轉線又有什麼小技巧？學懂這些跑步禮儀，大家跑得安全又開心！. 〈戰神跑〉－楊志成. 「百公里戰神」楊志成以雙腳詮釋超馬跑者的鋼鐵意志！日夜兼程的訓練為他贏得「不眠戰神」之名，堅持完成每場賽道，是對自己與支持者的一份交代。楊志成將征戰極限的系統化訓練，化為不同階層跑者的追夢階梯。從挑戰自我到開班授徒，始終秉持初心，「作為香港跑手，能推動全城運動水平進步，為此感到驕傲。.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：春暖花開去見你
programme.desc: 1991年，唐亦尋等人因火場案被判刑，出獄後他拼命打工供葉海棠讀書，二人甜蜜規劃未來。唐亦尋找回並修好郵筒，寫信詢問未來。沈曉軍父親來訪，透露當年曾幫葉海棠母親買過兩張逃離的船票，暗示母親並非故意拋棄她。2026年，余念和沈程準備回北星時接到通知，失蹤已久的余志勇找到了。在墓園裡，這個守護了女兒一生的男人，最終安詳離世.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Ta Kwu Ling: Villages at the Crossroads of Change
programme.desc: One border crossing, two villages, and generations of residents navigating the tides of change. The Heung Yuen Wai Control Point, the seventh land port between Hong Kong and Shenzhen, fully opened in 2023. To make way for it, Chuk Yuen Tsuen was entirely relocated, while Heung Yuen Wai Tsuen remained in place. Those displaced gained modern amenities but lost their ancestral land; those who stayed preserved tradition but missed opportunities for better living conditions. What is the ideal path for these two communities, across two generations.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集帶你越過南北之分，尋找隱身香港的河內家鄉味。店主Kenny與Julie堅持小店用心，每週親手空運食材、甚至搬運越南擺設回港，只為重現最地道的北越風情，例如河內牛柳粉和米紙卷。這裡沒有宣傳攻勢，卻有熟客為他們寫文拍片、首飾店主動提出聯乘。一碗湯粉背後，是兩位店主對越南味道的執著，與食客結下的真摯緣分.

programme.title: 千年陝菜
programme.desc: 退隱多年的大廚李水亮要在終南山下，用一道源自周代宮廷宴中的陝菜大菜招待老友，這道大菜是李水亮的傍身之技，會做的陝菜廚師寥寥無幾。製作時間長達數小時，在製作過程中，要不停舉着連食物重達20多斤的鐵叉上下翻動，這對年邁的李水亮體力上是個考驗。久不出手的李水亮最終能否成功？徐海軍是精通官府菜的大廚，官府菜中的代表菜他都信手拈來，而他尤其擅長一道海味大菜.

programme.title: 千年陝菜
programme.desc: 岩耳生長於漢江流域的懸崖上，採集者李平冒生命危險，為了家人的幸福踏上艱險之路。「六點烏」是陝南特有的珍稀烏雞品種，廚師唐世根用意想不到的方式烹製岩耳與烏雞，發揮兩者的特長。安康漢陰的石燕經營的餐廳以蘑菇菌湯聞名，帶有童年滋味的蘑菇宴深受喜愛.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次主題是雞蛋。我們會看看雞蛋從雞棚到上架的整個過程。大家去到札幌雞蛋流通中心，參觀雞蛋檢測的程序，最後包裝發售。最後當然不少得品嚐一下雞蛋料理.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 第二天就要開學，子軒卻還有日記沒有寫完，為了幫助子軒度過難關，灶君使出神力召喚老黃曆將時間倒流，改寫子軒命運，可萬事有因果，這也導致因為子軒過於專注寫日記，曾經發生的事情一一改變，更重要的是灶君因為子軒子涵搶奪吸塵器而誤落趙家的事情也在改變，難道灶君與趙家就此錯過.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君重新落回趙家發現趙家竟還有一灶君，原來是小衰神假扮灶君，看著家人不認識自己，幾次喚醒家人記憶無果灶君失望離去，小衰神自覺擊敗灶君離開趙家，不料被突擊返家的灶君擊退，趙家眾人恢復記憶，看到重新回來的灶君眾人激動不已.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 胡同裡出現了一個神秘的黑魅賊，專偷小孩的玩具。如福們決定找出這個賊，幫助小朋友找回玩具。經過查探，他們抓住了黑魅賊，竟是一隻調皮的貓.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 嫲嫲誤食靈芝後化身舞蹈狂人。菲菲找到解藥，但烏鴉搶走了靈芝。俠魚與烏鴉搏鬥，搶回一半靈芝。嫲嫲恢復正常，剩下的靈芝則讓朝風重新獲得能量.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 位於厄瓜多爾海岸一千多公里以外的太平洋島嶼——加拉帕戈斯群島，遠離大陸土地、長久無人居往，加上當地的火山地貌，成就物種獨立演化，因而孕育出特有的動物品，然而，這些特有物種正面臨嚴重威脅。讓海水升溫的厄爾尼諾現象出現得越來越頻繁，嚴重影響著群島特有的海鬣蜥和加拉帕戈斯企鵝的食物來源。同時，人類無意引入的入侵物種正在群島迅速繁殖，威脅著所有本地物種的生存。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月27日 星期二 晚上10時. . More than 1000 kilometers off the coast of Ecuador, the Galapagos Islands form an amazing archipelago in the middle of the Pacific. The Galapagos and its volcanoes are home to unique animal species that have developed away from the outside world, on islands that humans have only occupied for a short time. . However, several serious problems threaten today these endemic species. The climatic phenomenon El Niño, which warms the ocean and takes away a large part of their food from the marine iguanas and the Galapagos penguins, is occurring more and more frequently. And, on land, the unintentional introduction of invasive species, brought by humans, and their rapid multiplication threaten all native species. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.07.27 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 在人類的歷史長河中，災難往往是變革的催化劑。明清小冰期逼使有識之士引入美洲作物，改寫農業面貌；黑死病瓦解歐洲舊秩序，催生人文主義思潮；經濟大蕭條則令各國重新審視放任政策，開創社會福利新局。本集與觀眾重回歷史，探討人類如何在絕境中化危為機。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 謝偉傑(香港中文大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究).

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第四集曹星如/跑者背後. 〈跑者愛分享〉－曹星如. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與「神奇小子」曹星如（Rex）從紅隧口跑到中環摩天輪，探索港島海濱的熱門打卡點！Rex分享他在拳擊與跑步的共同領悟，強調呼吸節奏的重要性，慢下來才能更好地收放自如。昔日孤身擂臺的他，如今與Inez奔跑中並肩暢談：「無論擂台或跑道，努力付出超越自己進步！」. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－做好擺手，可免受傷？. 跑步不只是腳步，擺手姿勢也很重要！錯誤的擺手容易造成膝蓋與關節受傷。正確方法是雙臂貼近身體，上擺至胸口、下擺至腰部，像鐘擺般前後擺動。搭配彈力帶訓練，強化肌肉力量，跑得更安全、更有效率！. 〈跑者背後〉. 香港跑界流傳一句金句：「無獎都要有相！」每場跑步比賽背後，都有賴大量義工通力合作，更少不了攝影師沿途為跑手捕捉珍貴的回憶。作為跑步義工的蘇永權，以及經營跑步相片平台的林志倫，他們究竟如何投入這些幕後工作，默默為跑壇貢獻呢.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵劇 牡丹亭驚夢
programme.sub-title: 粵劇 牡丹亭驚夢 (下集)
programme.desc: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵劇牡丹亭驚夢(下集). 《牡丹亭驚夢》是著名劇作家唐滌生，改編傳統崑劇《牡丹亭》而成的粵劇。. 故事講述宋朝太守之女杜麗娘在牡丹亭夢到書生柳夢梅而相戀，麗娘醒後思憶成疾而死，. 後來麗娘回生與夢梅結為夫婦，怎料不為麗娘父親杜寶認可，最後在皇帝調停下終能團圓。. 著名粵劇演員龍貫天與多位粵劇界年青新星傾力演出，配合全新舞台佈景燈光設計，展現. 粵劇美學新境界。. 粵劇片段由香港粵劇藝術團提供。. 表演者：. 龍貫天飾皇帝. 黃成彬飾柳夢梅. 劉麗飾杜麗娘. 梁煒康飾陳最良. 黎耀威飾杜寶. 吳敏婷飾春香.

programme.title: 璀璨藝匯2025
programme.desc: 香港學界一群熱愛表演藝術的同學，以努力和熱情綻放青春及璀璨的光芒。. 教育局致力推動藝術教育，鼓勵跨文化藝術交流。節目通過音樂、朗誦、舞蹈及戲劇等豐富多元的表演形式，展現年青一代的藝術才華，為觀眾帶來耳目一新的視聽享受。. 曲目：. 《殺⼿探⼽》銅管樂小組. 聖士提反書院. 《這個世界不太冷》當代舞. 保良局董玉娣中學. 《贈白馬王彪-唐羚》粵語二人朗誦. 聖保羅男女中學. Badine (Scherzo)色士風獨奏. 軒尼詩道官立小學(銅鑼灣). 《夜深沉》古箏獨奏. 中華基金中學. The Wind in the Willows (柳林風聲)英語二人戲劇朗誦. 迦密主恩中學. 《弦樂四重奏Op.19 No.4 第一樂章》弦樂小組. 皇仁書院. 《韃靼舞》俄羅斯舞. 聖保祿學校(中學部).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.desc: 位於厄瓜多爾海岸一千多公里以外的太平洋島嶼——加拉帕戈斯群島，遠離大陸土地、長久無人居往，加上當地的火山地貌，成就物種獨立演化，因而孕育出特有的動物品，然而，這些特有物種正面臨嚴重威脅。讓海水升溫的厄爾尼諾現象出現得越來越頻繁，嚴重影響著群島特有的海鬣蜥和加拉帕戈斯企鵝的食物來源。同時，人類無意引入的入侵物種正在群島迅速繁殖，威脅著所有本地物種的生存。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月27日 星期二 晚上10時. . And, on land, the unintentional introduction of invasive species, brought by humans, and their rapid multiplication threaten all native species. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.07.27 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團 - 北京及山東
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.desc: 徐家柏為了林心姿購買了一套公寓，林心姿開心的從唐影家搬走了。許子詮憋不住約唐影吃飯，唐影看著眼前的許子詮，不自覺地說起以前曾暗戀的程恪。唐影上班途中撞上了目標客戶馬其遠的車，馬其遠載她一起去公司，會議後王玉玊和唐影說，馬其遠是看上唐影了.

承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：姚志明搬進獨立屋
programme.desc: 麥承歡在興安里沉穩應對員工鬧事風波，贏得員工支持。姚志明收到集團總裁發令，一個月必須收購興安里的壓力。承歡母女關係緊張，她力勸家人搬離獨立屋未果，反而是姚志明搬進了獨立屋，試圖拉近與承歡的距離。興安里生意低迷，承歡能力挽狂瀾嗎.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：興安里拿下婚禮的首單
programme.desc: 麥承歡與朋友聯手拿下興安里婚禮首單，弟弟承早到興安里道賀，承歡察覺弟弟與朋友的關係變化。姚志明扛住了壓力，支持承歡經營好興安里，兩人關係曖昧升溫。承歡媽媽終於同意搬離獨立屋，卻因承歡為穩定員工軍心，暫緩買房而失敗告終，承歡能平衡家人與事業的挑戰嗎.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 胡飛意外地把果醬噴到哥布林的高塔上，由於哥布林的下屬需要清理果醬，英雄們被迫收留哥布林大王。哥布林大王作客時感到很快樂，他決定永久居住並一起執行任務！為了不與哥布林大王同住，英雄們設計了一個任務令他很快會跑回自己的塔裡.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 這是節目第一次介紹黃豆粉。黃豆粉是日本傳統食品，由大豆製成。北海道大豆產量高居日本第一。只需烘焙及研磨即可製成黃豆粉。今次亦會有專業廚師教我們烹調簡單黃豆粉菜餚.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：十五好心攙扶老太太被要求賠償
programme.desc: 十五周末回家路上，好心攙扶摔倒在路邊的老太太，卻沒想到被老太太和其家人當成撞倒自己的肇事者，不依不饒。十五向楊明彪保證自己沒有撞人，楊明彪力挺兒子，甚至網上懸賞提供線索者賞金五萬，勢必要追尋事情真相.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 27歲的德法混血兒張國德Yannick，四圍發掘香港各地的人與事，分享在香港的生活點滴。今集主持Vita會同Yannick一齊傾下計.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第三十一集：母親的選擇
programme.desc: 顧嶼在醫院婦科撞見蘇橙橙後誤以為是她懷孕，並將此事告訴唐奇，蘇橙橙只得無奈承認，卻被蘇青梨無意中聽到，要求唐奇立即舉辦婚禮，唐奇不得已交代事實。同時，面對對自己百般照顧的林媛在聽到了顧嶼對孩子的態度後，終於告訴了顧嶼，懷孕的那個人不是蘇橙橙，是自己.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 這集將以鳥聲為引，帶領大家進入香港的雀鳥世界。. 自然教育工作者 Matthew 與凱靈，兩夫婦走進繁忙的沙田中央公園，示範如何透過敏銳的聽覺去辨雀，. 在城市的喧囂中捕捉自然頻率；並在貫文空間的專題展覽《川流大山》裡，展示生活在大帽山的鳥種。. 與此同時，香港觀鳥會研究主任Jay，在鶴藪利用不同的生態聲學技術，觀測香港大自然的鳥類狀況。. 透過收錄郊野的鳥聲，訓練人工智能的辨鳥能力，幫助人類進一步窺探鳥類的奧秘.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 印度洋拯救任務
programme.sub-title: 印度洋拯救任務(上) From La Reunion to the Seychelles
programme.desc: 無窮無盡的印度洋是最後一個自然天堂的所在，碧綠清澈的海水中，密布絢爛的珊瑚，組成偏遠的環礁。. 印度洋整個海域尚未完全經過探索，很多珊瑚礁在地圖上仍未標記。考察船阿拉古斯二號從留尼旺島出發，標誌我們這個時代，最偉大科學歷險之旅開始。. 考察旅程由摩納哥親王阿爾貝二世基金會發起，歷時六週，船上滙聚了一百位世界級海洋科學精英。研究船沿著馬斯克林深海高原進入西印度洋，目的地是塞舌爾群島西南部的亞達伯拉環礁，蕯耶迪馬尼亞沙洲的沉没群島亦首次成為研究對象。. 本節目跟隨科學家團的足迹，如實紀錄了他們檢測珊瑚礁，追踪瀕危綠海龜的過程。他們還發現了一些前所未見的生物。搜集到的資料數據仍有待分析整合，然而，這一次科學探險之旅無疑有助進一步掌握我們的海洋生態，從而了解全球暖化的後果。. The endless expanses of the Indian Ocean are home to the last natural paradises: Remote atolls surrounded by coral reefs in crystal clear water. Whole regions of this ocean are still unexplored, many reefs are not marked on any map. The departure of the research vessel Agulhas II from the island of La Réunion marks the beginning of one of the greatest scientific adventures of our time. The expedition, initiated by Monaco Explorations with the support of the Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation, lasted six weeks and led into the Western Indian Ocean along the Mascarene Plateau. On board are one hundred experts who are among the world's elite marine scientists. On their mission, they discover never-before-seen creatures like the Dumbo Octopus and fabulous animals like the State Jellyfish, which resembles a floating work of art. Several hundreds of gigabytes of data are still waiting to be processed, but one thing is already certain: the expedition will help to better understand the physics and biology of the oceans and thus the consequences of global warming.

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團 - 北京及山東
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：承歡被醉酒男糾纏

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：張培生的女兒出現
programme.desc: 姚志明從警局把張培生的女兒接走。承歡歸家，承歡媽媽喜不自勝，又為承歡婚事操心，卻因承歡反鎖房門，感到母女關係已疏遠。劉婉玉有意撮合承歡和遠房侄子。另一邊，張培生的女兒到獨立屋冒充姚志明女友，引發誤會。承歡與姚志明的關係將何去何從.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 阿花是人生導師獨角獸烏娜的超級粉絲，她提議大家陪烏娜前往下一個演出地點。阿花對烏娜過於熱情，甚至無視自己的朋友，因此引來其他英雄的不滿。當烏娜面對危險時，阿花得到英雄們的協助，一起拯救烏娜，眾人亦原諒了阿花.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 在麵粉廠參觀將小麥變成麵粉的過程，在拉麵廠參觀將麵粉變成拉麵的過程。最後我們吃了北海道小麥拉麵。味道究竟是如何呢.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十七集：唐曉薇講課令孩子喜歡
programme.desc: 特意精心打扮的唐曉薇，講述有趣的生活小常識，引來孩子們喜歡。結果，唐曉薇講課的影片發進家長群，引來了不小的風波。家長群裏的媽媽們含沙射影批判唐曉薇的穿着問題，引來眾人包括戴靜的容貌危機.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 各人人生際遇經歷都不同，每個階段都會有一首最貼近內心的作品。對人生前路的迷茫、面對與愛人分手的傷心等。今集「深情慢歌」系列精選多首動人之作，哪一首歌會最觸動你的內心？. 主持. 阮頌陽.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.desc: 為了一圓參與巴西戰舞對戰的心願，維克托遠赴巴西薩爾瓦多，跟隨一位大師在其位於貧民窟的學校學習。這所學校不僅是孩子們遠離暴力及毒品的避風港，更是當地社群的精神支柱。. 在過程中，維克托了解到巴西戰舞誕生的血淚史，並體會到這項運動如何讓非裔巴西族群找回對自身文化根源的自豪與歸屬感。旅程最後，維克托終達成心願，參與了一場盛大的圍圈對戰。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年5月19日 星期二 晚上10時. . Victor journeys into the heart of Salvador, Brazil, to fulfill his dream of competing in a Capoeira Roda. He trains at a school led by a master, tucked deep within a local favela. More than just a place of practice, the school serves as a vital refuge for youth escaping violence and drugs, standing as a spiritual anchor for the community. . Ultimately, Victor realizes his ambition, stepping into the traditional Roda for a battle. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.05.19 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集聚焦賽事選手背後以不屈赴夢，以熱血傳神的故事，走進全盲運動員楊曉婷、單腿球王何憶義、九金王蔣裕燕，以及新疆盲人足球隊等代表人物的世界。他們身殘志堅，不懼命運挑戰，以勇往直前的信念追逐夢想，用汗水澆築榮耀，生動詮釋「向陽而生」的力量，弘揚中華體育精神，讓每一份堅持都閃耀光芒。. 播映時間：2月3日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 阿花是人生導師獨角獸烏娜的超級粉絲，她提議大家陪烏娜前往下一個演出地點。阿花對烏娜過於熱情，甚至無視自己的朋友，因此引來其他英雄的不滿。當烏娜面對危險時，阿花得到英雄們的協助，一起拯救烏娜，眾人亦原諒了阿花.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 在麵粉廠參觀將小麥變成麵粉的過程，在拉麵廠參觀將麵粉變成拉麵的過程。最後我們吃了北海道小麥拉麵。味道究竟是如何呢.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.sub-title: 第十一集: 很想你 … 假的
programme.desc: 許子詮回到北京，在畫展上見到唐影和馬其遠，心中不是味兒。唐影不知道自己和馬其遠之間的分寸應該怎麼拿捏，向王玉玊求救。趁徐家柏出差，林心姿約唐影吐槽徐家柏管得多嚴，不可穿著暴露。唐影和許子詮再次見面，互相說着沒準的情話.

承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：姚志明再表白
programme.desc: 張培生的女兒好奇姚志明和麥家的關係，於是對助理威逼利誘，終於鎖定了情敵麥承歡。張培生的女兒毛遂自薦來興安里實習，承歡告訴她要就按流程來投簡歷。承歡親人縱容孫子，和其他住客發生矛盾，承歡幫理不幫親，被數落。承歡帶姚志明坐上觀光巴士，姚志明再表白.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集：承歡弟弟離家出走
programme.desc: 獨立屋內，承歡媽媽不問青紅皂白地讓細仔承早向表哥道歉，承早受盡委屈，頭也不回地沖出獨立屋。而承歡姨父見此更加囂張，最後姚志明以房東身份出現，趕走了姨父一家。夜幕降臨，承歡媽媽發現兒子離家出走，女兒有家不回，內心低落.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 快樂委員會失了蹤，英雄們必須找回他們。原來，巨人八哥一直在收集森林生物，當中包括快樂委員會成員，情況就像冰冰收集森林魔獸卡一樣！冰冰必須運用她的智慧對抗巨人八哥，以釋放這些森林朋友.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次會參觀日本最大的生乳生產地別海町。在那裏，我們遇到了從零開始投入酪農事業的家庭，他們一家人過着充實的酪農生活.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：景婷婷偷偷給初一零食引發矛盾
programme.desc: 每家有每家的煩惱，三家湊在一起，建立了「改毛病群」，相互鼓勵要改掉孩子們的小毛病。初一越來越挑食，景婷婷怕初一吃不飽，不得不繼續給她零食果腹。景婷婷偷偷給初一帶零食到學校，引發楊明彪和景婷婷矛盾.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 巴拿馬，一個面積稍微比瑞士大的國家，除了以其壯觀的運河而聞名，還有其他方面值得我們認識。 在一個自然荒野日益罕見，而且原住民人口逐漸消失的世界中，這個保存完好的國家絕對值得一遊。它繁茂的自然景觀、多元的部落文化，以及歷史悠久的景點，都是由太平洋和加勒比海之間的貿易風所造就而成的。而火山一帶來的特殊氛圍就更值得我們探索。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年8月27日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 綠色是流動的文明，是跨山河的脈動。一場深刻的交通技術迭代正讓出行更智能、更有效率、更貼近大自然。從風馳電掣的「鋼鐵巨龍」，到虛擬軌道的「地面地鐵」；從公路貨運「空中充電」，到低空飛行汽車。綠色交通網正編織空天地一體的未來.

承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：承歡媽媽再鬧笑話
programme.desc: 承歡媽媽來到興安里，碰上承歡正在召開員工大會。員工大會上，承歡媽媽見員工挑釁承歡，忍不住替承歡出頭，結果被吐槽老闆管理方式有問題。承歡強壓怒火，鎮住場面，拉媽媽離開興安里。入夜，承歡在姚志明陪同下回家，母女倆促膝長談，承歡直言不知道如何跟媽媽相處.

programme.title: 承歡記
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：親子活動當日
programme.desc: 承歡弟弟向承歡坦白自己遇到的問題，他要做女友撫養權官司的律師，還要籌辦一場親子活動，消弭女友母子之間的隔閡。麥承歡全力支持，她邀請姚志明參加周末的親子活動。親子活動當日，一陣風刮過，活動背景板搖晃起來，幸好姚志明及時趕到，幫承歡一起撐住了背景板.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 森林調查員會每年都會訪問森林，檢查其「快樂」指數。菲斯派出英雄們去執行古怪的任務，以保證快樂指數。然而，他很快便發現森林原來已經很快樂.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集主題是豆沙，是和菓子的主角。豆沙的原材料大部分源自北海道。北海道紅豆產量佔全日本90%，而甜菜糖則佔100%。. 參觀札幌的豆沙廠時，隊長對和菓子及和菓及師傅的手藝嘖嘖稱奇.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：「我喜歡你」紙條
programme.desc: 戴靜稱劉向上是不是有點大驚小怪。誰知話音剛落，唐曉薇前來，稱發現糖豆口袋裏，別的女孩給糖豆寫的紙條，依稀可見的字跡「我喜歡你」，讓大家為孩子們可能的早熟而擔心，楊明彪急得團團轉.

programme.sub-title: 第6集: 隕石、老照片的收藏
programme.desc: 張勃藏有近百塊頂級隕石。他手中的橄欖石石鐵隕石、定向隕石等，都是隕石圈內的不二藏品。另一名收藏者霖峰，是一個老照片收藏者，他將自己的收入、目前人生的三分之一，都投入在了上萬件老照片.

programme.desc: 昔日同伙老夏墓碑被砸，三叉戟得知兇手是魏勝毅後，決心要逮到他。這時，專案組過來緊急請三叉戟去幫忙傳銷騙案，卻發現疑犯正是魏勝毅。正當他們就要抓住魏勝毅，他自稱是代罪羊後便跳樓自殺了。崔鐵軍認為此事有可疑，決定重查此案並游說徐潘二人加入三叉戟工作室.

programme.desc: 森林調查員會每年都會訪問森林，檢查其「快樂」指數。菲斯派出英雄們去執行古怪的任務，以保證快樂指數。然而，他很快便發現森林原來已經很快樂.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈

programme.desc: 員工大會上，承歡被廖剛潑了一身水，但她依然堅持開除廖剛，移送警方處理。在眾人的注視下，承歡重申興安里的規章制度，希望其他人不要再讓她失望。姚志明把發燒的承歡送到醫院，承歡痛定思痛，重新振作起來，她把前同事招入麾下。姚志明的父親姚仁富突然出現在獨立屋.

programme.title: 承歡記

programme.desc: 入夜，承歡媽媽得知姚志明的父親住進興安里，直覺此人沒安好心，打算第二天去興安裏一探究竟。承歡媽媽剛進興安里就聽到志明父親煽動員工對抗承歡，頓時氣結。志明父親為緩和氣氛帶承歡媽媽喝咖啡，他又試探承歡和志明的關係，志明父親為篤定承歡不簡單.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 濰坊、威海、青島
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.sub-title: Ta Kwu Ling: The Village School
programme.desc: Nestled in the forests of Ta Kwu Ling, a secluded rural school, Ling Ying Public School, stands as a testament to community spirit. Founded in 1958, it once teetered on the edge of closure due to low enrollment. Through a remarkable turnaround, it embraced “forest campus” and “positive education” models, becoming a cherished village school. With a devoted principal, caring teachers, joyful students, and supportive alumni, the school feels like a family brimming with warmth. This episode explores the challenges and triumphs of rural education, told through the stories of those who keep it alive.

programme.desc: F國詐騙集團，張小北等人被囚禁學習詐騙技倆。張小北同房有人偷跑出去報警，錢天心把這人行刑重罰。剛剛抵達F國的安旎和何陸源等人被盯梢，當地警官警告四人根本不瞭解腳踩的這片土地。另一邊，深夜裡，趙冀凱在打秘密電話，差點被李儀棠發現.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 安旎等四人察覺所處情況不妙，安旎提議主動出擊，拜訪當地檢察官拉斐爾並向其求助，但遭拒絕。張小北聽到中國員警來了F國的消息，亦意外的在詐騙集團內碰到了心心念唸的女主播梁穎。他決定帶同被囚禁的梁穎逃出去.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 擁有屬於自己的安樂窩是很多香港人的夢想。從戰前的花園城市夢，到戰後因應建築法規的寬緊，塑造出香港獨有的「怪獸大廈」奇觀，亦成為建造大型屋苑的契機。世界上最大的私人屋苑項目，竟然就在香港。本集帶大家了解香港的私樓發展之路！. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). #私人屋苑#美孚新邨#私樓#安樂窩#學人沙龍.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第五集蘇麗珊/安多酚彩妝. 〈跑者愛分享〉－蘇麗珊. 跑步要打卡是常識吧！兩位美女梁諾妍（Inez）與蘇麗珊（Cecilia），由西環跑到大口環，邊聊邊笑邊拍照。她們經過海濱長廊、大學校園、泳棚，實行來一場「動態冥想」。Cecilia更分享了她跑步的感想：「我覺得跑步畀我最大樂趣係辛苦！」. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－Zone 2 訓練是什麼？. 你以為「跑得慢」就一定無效？其實，透過Zone 2訓練，以最大心率約60-70%的輕鬆心率範圍運動，身體便會高效燃燒脂肪，提升基礎代謝與耐力。節目中會教你簡單計算方法，並示範如何靠感覺—「能輕鬆說話、不感吃力」—去掌握訓練強度，助你跑得更輕鬆、更持久！. 〈安多酚彩妝〉. 女跑團團長林茵茵，創立了香港最美麗自信的「誘騙集團」？她凝聚一群熱愛跑步的女性每月一跑，又自費出版女生跑步小誌，宣揚跑步的強大力量。跑步帶來的安多酚，就是她們最自然動人的美麗彩妝.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：香港當代民族管弦樂經典音樂作品粵港澳大灣區巡演
programme.sub-title: 香港當代民族管弦樂經典音樂作品粵港澳大灣區巡演 (第一集)
programme.desc: 香港城市中樂團成立於1994年，三十年來，一直為推動香港中樂發展、發揚中國文化而不懈努力。. 今次巡演為觀眾帶來了幾代香港作曲家的經典金曲，包括曾葉發為慶賀香港97回歸祖國創作的《安晴》、麥偉鑄飄逸靈動描寫湖光山色的《古箏與樂隊-自在山雲間》、陳能濟富有莊周哲學思想的《夢蝶》、陳永華熱情洋溢的《八駿》；值得特別期待的是已故著名作曲家葉純之先生1991 年所創作的《二胡協奏曲-辛棄疾》，該作品謳歌了偉大愛國詞人辛棄疾氣吞山河卻又是英雄落寞的一生，在塵封32年後重見天日，本次此曲演出乃內地首演，由程秀榮擔任獨奏，國寶級指揮大師84歲高齡的胡炳旭先生執棒，意義非凡。. 壓軸的還有大型民樂團伴奏的合唱作品《月光光童謠組曲》，是香港中文大學（深圳）音樂學院副院長陳永華教授於青年時代在加拿大留學時創作的組曲，由《中秋月》《月光光》《上學歌》三首樂曲組成，旋律親切優美，歌詞朗朗上口。此次合唱由來自龍崗區龍城初級中學合唱團和龍外（集團）新亞洲學校的學生童聲合唱團擔任，樂團合奏的是香港城市中樂團演奏家們和龍崗區音樂家協會龍聲民族樂團青少年團組成的聯合樂團，超大規模的表演陣容不僅體現了深港兩地民族音樂國隊友好合作、融合發展的良好態勢，也彰顯了龍崗區青少年傳承優秀傳統文化的蓬勃力量，一定給觀眾帶來不一樣的震撼和體驗。音樂會片段由香港城市中樂團攝製及提供.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：香港當代民族管弦樂經典音樂作品粵港澳大灣區巡演
programme.sub-title: 香港當代民族管弦樂經典音樂作品粵港澳大灣區巡演(第二集)
programme.desc: 香港城市中樂團成立於1994年，三十年來，一直為推動香港中樂發展、發揚中國文化而不懈努力。. 今集香港城市中樂團繼續帶觀眾跨越香港、深圳和珠海三地欣賞香港作曲家經典名作：梅廣釗源自傳統名曲以全新的現代技法寫成的《彩雲追月狂想曲》、羅偉倫及鄭濟民用笛子為主奏樂器訴說家喻戶曉的民間愛情故事《笛子協奏曲-白蛇傳》、陳培勛氣勢恢弘的民族交響音畫《流水》、黃學揚描繪維多利亞港夜景的《維港夜曲》、特別推薦指揮大師瞿春泉專程執棒已故中國音樂美學大師、作曲家葉純之的二胡協奏曲《辛棄疾》，藝術總監程秀榮再次擔綱二胡獨奏，加上港珠兩地100多位音樂家組成的超大型樂隊協奏，共創一段樂壇傳奇。音樂會片段由香港城市中樂團攝製及提供.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 27歲的德法混血兒張國德Yannick，四圍發掘香港各地的人與事，分享在香港的生活點滴。今集主持Vita會同Yannick一齊傾下計.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：瘦身男女
programme.desc: 旅居日本的 Mini Mo (鄭秀文飾),因為初戀情人黑川的離開.在十年間,由九頭身美人漸變成一個大肥婆.在潦倒之時,她認識同屬肥人一族的賣刀佬肥佬(劉德華飾),二人頓成鬥氣怨家.肥佬知道 Mini 的可憐經歷後,為了助她重奪愛人心:無所不用其極,助她減肥,令她為之感動. Mini 瘦身成功,如期赴約,黑川為之驚豔.當她躊躇誰屬最愛之際,肥佬已消失在茫茫人海. . .

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: Oscar 和寶琴的笑容，交織成樂園裹美麗的笑聲。在這裹，他們找到的不止是工作，而是成長的空間，一步步建立自己夢想的生活。. Oscar（自閉症），為了確保自己準時到樂園上班，他清晨4點多就會起床預備出門，花上兩個多小時到達樂園上班，而他最期待的是把清潔的工作做好後，下班時到樂園找心儀的卡通人物合照，獎勵自己；不用到樂園兼職的日子，他會到社福機構上學接受職業訓練課程，學習工作所需的各種技巧。而在樂園任職裁縫的寶琴（聽障），由釘鈕、車拉鏈學起，每個步驟她都用心地記在筆記裏，經過兩年多的努力，近月她第一次參與製作卡通人物的表演服，在巡遊上看到自己的作品，成為了寶琴很大的動力。. 樂園除了與社福機構合作，制定相關的職業訓練課程，每年也會聘請身心有障礙人士，安排伙伴協助他們投入工作。只要受到合適的職業訓練，殘疾人士也可以在職場上找到夢想的工作.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集聚焦賽事選手背後以不屈赴夢，以熱血傳神的故事，走進全盲運動員楊曉婷、單腿球王何憶義、九金王蔣裕燕，以及新疆盲人足球隊等代表人物的世界。他們身殘志堅，不懼命運挑戰，以勇往直前的信念追逐夢想，用汗水澆築榮耀，生動詮釋「向陽而生」的力量，弘揚中華體育精神，讓每一份堅持都閃耀光芒。. 播映時間：2月3日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Oscar and Buu Cam's smiles intertwine to create beautiful laughter in the Disney. In this place, they find not just a job, but also a space for growth, gradually building their dream lives. . Oscar (who has autism) wakes up early at around 4 a.m. to ensure he arrives at the park on time for work, spending more than two hours commuting. What he looks forward to most is finishing his cleaning duties well and then taking photos with his favorite cartoon characters at the end of the day as a reward. On days when he doesn't work at the park, he attends a social welfare organization to participate in vocational training courses, learning various skills needed for work. . Buu Cam (who is hearing impaired), works as a tailor at the park, starting with button sewing and zipper work. She diligently notes down each step in her notebook. After more than two years of effort, she recently participated in making costumes for cartoon character performances, and seeing her work during the parade has been a tremendous motivation for her. . The park not only collaborates with social welfare organizations to develop relevant vocational training programs but also hires individuals with physical and mental disabilities each year, arranging partners to assist them in entering the workforce. With the right vocational training, people with disabilities can find their dream jobs in the workplace.

programme.title: 相會雙城
programme.sub-title: 相會雙城 - 咫尺之情 (下)
programme.desc: 五、六十年代，是香港裁縫業的黃金時代，一班上海紅幫裁縫紛紛來到香港謀生。就在那個年代，男士定制服裝品牌—Ascot Chang 應運而生，成為行內數一數二的品牌。. 這個品牌在香港紥根超過七十年，即使在機械化大批生產嘅時代，他們依然堅持在香港自設工場，每一個工序都是全人手製作，一針一線都保留着手作的溫度。. 創業難，守業更難。第二代掌舵人張宗琪（Tony）在八十年代末慢慢接手爸爸張子斌的生意；憑着一股韌力積極開拓市場，先後在世界各地及內地開設門市，把上海紅幫裁縫的技藝帶上國際舞台。近年他眼見香港裁縫業出現斷層，決心回到家鄉寧波奉化開設廠房。在這片紅幫裁縫的發源地，他花了數年時間培育新一代裁縫人才，讓這裏成為另一個薪火相傳的生產基地。. 至於留學美國的第三代張奕庭（Justin），在紐約分店工作時，偶遇爺爺張子斌的舊客人，那位客人帶着自己的下一代來做西裝。這份跨越時空的信任深深打動了Justin，也堅定了他繼承家業的決心。十多年前，Justin回港協助Tony打理業務，不斷尋求突破：主動做模特兒拍Reels，與其他男士服飾品牌合作推出聯乘產品，還聯同業界友好舉辦香港紳士遊行（Suit Walk ）— Sartorial Asia 2025，一心要把這份手藝與精神傳承得更遠。. 正是憑着張子斌在異鄉打拼的勇氣，加上下一代對家族事業的擔當，讓這家人對家、國的情感愈加深厚，也勾勒出他們與香港共同成長的軌跡.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: The dream to “take shade under rice crops” is awakening the sleeping land for us to sow seeds of hope on saline-alkali soil. On the barren land once dubbed the “Scar of the Earth”, innovative technology has made harvest bountiful, and safeguarded the “Giant Panda of Arable Land”. The black soil now brims with vitality and the foundation of food security is getting stronger as the land heals and becomes increasingly fertile.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: By transforming sunlight, wind and river currents of our homeland into green energy to power our future, homes are lit up by the golden rays of deserts and factories are run on green power. When the massive “Qihang” wind turbines spin to capture the force of nature; When zero-carbon factories operate efficiently in the dark, we can see that clean energy is reshaping the genes of Chinese products.

programme.title: 小儀與13型男
